title: Sync Transport Report
description: Machine-readable contract for the sync session push preparation report (ADR-0020, adjudication 5). The report is preparation/report-only: proposedOps are structured operations (verb + confined paths or derived commit message), never shell strings — parsing strings into execution is an injection-shaped hazard the contract removes. External executors consume this artifact; Amber itself never executes the proposed operations. Versioned per ADR-0012.

schemaVersion.description: Report schema version. Bumped on breaking shape changes (ADR-0012).

mode.description: Always prepare: the report proposes operations, never executes them.

envelopeCount.description: Number of envelopes found in the sync home.

envelopeIds.description: UUIDs of the envelopes prepared for transport.

envelopePaths.description: Repository-relative POSIX paths of the envelope files.

affectedPaths.description: Every file under the sync home a transport commit would include. Plain strings: the state-dir seam can relocate .amber, so the schema does not pin a path prefix.

proposedOps.description: Structured proposed git operations, in replay order. Closed verb set; no shell strings.

paths.description: Confined staging paths for git add.

message.description: Commit message derived from the report (deterministic, replayable).

remoteConfigured.description: Whether a git remote is configured (read-only query). git push is only proposed when true.

conflictCount.description: Pending conflicts in the sync conflict ledger.

refusedCount.description: Refused envelopes currently tracked in the admission pipeline.

errors.description: Structured errors (including any self-validation violation of this schema).
